thread:
ops-bot: PAGER — infra: gpu-provisioner-us-central1 failing to create GPUs (quotaExceeded). Autoscaler stuck in PendingCreate state. AlertID: INF-GPU-QUOTA-1725. Link: https://pager/redwood/INF-GPU-QUOTA-1725 :rotating_light:

emily_oncall: acked. I'm oncall for infra. looking at autoscaler logs now.

sam_sre: I see repeated 403s from Compute API when creating A100 nodes: 
```
ERROR: compute.instances.insert: quotaExceeded: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for zone us-central1-a.
```
We were trying to spin up 12 GPUs for the inference-warm pool and got denied. Regional GPU quota shows 48/48 in project.

kevin_infra: confirming: project quota for "NVIDIA_TESLA_A100": 48, usage 48. Warmpool + burst + on-demand used it all. There was an unscheduled burst from dedupe-job earlier.

maya_ml_support: customer impact check: we have elevated request latency and throttled requests for customers on hosted tier in us-central1. Some requests are falling back to lower-capacity models (latency up ~600ms for some endpoints). Not full outage but degraded.

emily_oncall: initial mitigation options: 1) reroute new requests from us-central1 to us-west2 pools via runtime routing (fast, no infra changes), 2) evict noncritical warmpool tasks and free GPUs (risky), 3) request quota increase from GCP (slow). I'm going to start 1 and 2 in parallel.

sam_sre: good. I'll start routing change. Updating the routing policy now — doing a canary 10% -> us-west2 then ramp. API call: 
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/v1/routing/policies/shift -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" -d '{"from_region":"us-central1","to_region":"us-west2","percent":10,"route_type":"inference"}'
```
Will monitor token-level errors.

kevin_infra: I'll drain warmpool-noncritical nodes and stop a couple of batch workers to free up 8 GPUs. Running drain script: 
```
./tools/drain_pool.sh --pool warmpool-mgmt --remove 4
gcloud compute instances delete batch-worker-xyz --zone=us-central1-b --quiet
```
Expect GPUs free in ~90s.

ops-bot: SYSTEM: Routing policy update queued (req id rp-9f3). Warmpool drain initiated (task id dp-32).

emily_oncall: canary 10% started ~30s ago. Early telemetry: error rate in canary is normal. Latency for canary requests to us-west2 ~120ms higher but within SLO for hosted customers. Increasing to 40% now.

sam_sre: ramp to 40% done. Monitoring queue length for us-central1 inference queue: it stabilized then started shrinking. Original queue growth hit peak ~1200 requests. Now down to 230.

maya_ml_support: note: some enterprise customers have pinned region=us-central1 in Dedicated; they will still see impacted behavior. We should notify Customer Success.

emily_oncall: agreed. @maya, can you open a CS ticket for pinned-region customers and post an ETA? Put message in #customer-success. I'll draft a short status page blurb.

maya_ml_support: opened CS-8764, pinged account teams for 3 affected enterprise customers.

kevin_infra: warmpool drain freed 6 GPUs, but quota still at 48/48 due to reservations (we have 8 GPUs reserved for compliance tenants). We can temporarily reduce reserved count for non-critical reserved projects by patching reservation config. Proposing to lower reservation for project-compute-resv from 8->2.

sam_sre: do it, but annotate in audit. Command: 
```
gcloud compute reservations resize project-compute-resv --region=us-central1 --size=2
```
I will also open an emergency quota request with GCP support (raising regional A100 quota to 80). Ticket created: GCP-INC-10921.

ops-bot: SYSTEM: Quota request submitted (GCP-INC-10921). Support case link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/GCP-INC-10921

emily_oncall: temporary routing + reservation reduce + draining seems to be stabilizing things. We'll keep routing partially shifted (40%) for next 45 minutes then reassess.

pd-bot: On-call handover reminder: emily_oncall -> sam_sre in 30m. If you're not available, escalate to kevin_infra.

sam_sre: taking over primary. emily, handoff notes: routing at 40% to us-west2, warmpool reduced, quota ticket open, customer impact: some dedicated customers pinned to us-central1 impacted, CS notified. Any outstanding tasks?

emily_oncall: logged. Outstanding: monitor GCP support response, watch for quota increase, slowly ramp routing back when queue under 50 and latency stable. I'll post status page update: "Partial degradation in us-central1 for inference endpoints due to GPU quota limits; traffic partially rerouted; workarounds in progress."

maya_ml_support: Status page draft: 
```
We are experiencing increased latency for inference requests in region us-central1 due to GPU provisioning limits. Traffic has been partially rerouted to us-west2 and impacted customers have been notified. Engineers are actively mitigating; updates every 30 minutes.
```
Posting now.

sam_sre: monitoring dashboard shows node provisioning errors dropping to near-zero. Queue down to 80 and trending down. Keeping routing at 40% for now.

kevin_infra: GCP support replied: quota increase approved to 72 GPUs in 2 hours. They requested we confirm no further immediate provisioning attempts beyond current window. We'll keep routing to avoid re-surge.

emily_oncall: good. Plan: maintain partial routing and gradually ramp down when quota increase completes or when queue <50 for 20m. PD schedule: sam will be primary for the next 30m then follow normal rotation.

sam_sre: acknowledged. I'm on shift, will update every 15m or on status changes.

ops-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied: routing shift (40%), warmpool drain (-4), reservation resize (8->2), quota request GCP-INC-10921 opened. Current impact: partial latency increase for hosted in us-central1; pinned dedicated customers may see throttling.

emily_oncall: signing out of primary handoff. sam you have the bridge and PD handovers. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
